description.detailed_description: This image shows the bilateral upper arms of a patient with multiple skin lesions. The lesions vary in size and appear as ulcerations with surrounding discoloration. Some lesions have crusting or scabbing, and the skin shows diffuse hyperpigmentation. The patient is wearing a hospital gown, and medical equipment is visible, suggesting an inpatient setting.
